sections.title: Qué vas a aprender a decir

blocks.text: En la lección 9 decías lo que pasa ahora: I am reading. Ahora vas a contar lo que estaba pasando en un momento del pasado: «estaba leyendo un cómic», «estaba limpiando las botas cuando llamaste», «olía las flores mientras yo hablaba».

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
examples.translation: Estaba leyendo un cómic.

examples.en: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.
examples.translation: Estaban armando un rompecabezas.

examples.en: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
examples.translation: Estaba limpiando mis botines cuando llamaste.

examples.en: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.
examples.translation: Olía las flores mientras yo hablaba.

blocks.text: Aquí el español ayuda: «estaba leyendo» es I was reading. was / were hacen de «estaba», y -ing de «-ando / -iendo». Ojo: el «leía» del español también suele ser I was reading cuando hablas de lo que pasaba en ese momento.

examples.en: I was reading a comic book.
examples.translation: Estaba leyendo un cómic.

examples.en: She was using a colouring book.
examples.translation: Estaba usando un libro para colorear.

examples.en: I was cooking fried rice.
examples.translation: Estaba cocinando arroz frito.

examples.en: We were eating a spring roll.
examples.translation: Estábamos comiendo un rollito primavera.

examples.en: They were watching the soap bubbles.
examples.translation: Estaban mirando las burbujas de jabón.

fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: I was read a comic book.
fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: They was doing a jigsaw puzzle.
fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

drill.why: Con they en pasado, were; el -ing ya está.

blocks.text: El «no» va como siempre, después de la pieza: I wasn't playing, they weren't watching. wasn't es was not, weren't es were not. El -ing se queda.

examples.en: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.
examples.translation: No estaba jugando en el castillo inflable.

examples.en: I wasn't writing in the homework diary.
examples.translation: No estaba escribiendo en la agenda de tareas.

examples.en: I wasn't watching the robin.
examples.translation: No estaba mirando el petirrojo.

fixes.wrong: I no was playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

fixes.wrong: I didn't playing on the bouncy castle.
fixes.right: I wasn't playing on the bouncy castle.

blocks.text: La pregunta: la pieza delante, como en las lecciones 2 y 9. Were you playing in the paddling pool? Was he watching the owl? Aquí no va did: Did you playing es un error.

examples.en: Were you playing in the paddling pool?
examples.translation: ¿Estabas jugando en la alberca inflable?

examples.en: Was he jumping on the trampoline?
examples.translation: ¿Estaba saltando en el trampolín?

examples.en: Were you using the workbook?
examples.translation: ¿Estabas usando el cuaderno de ejercicios?

examples.en: Was he watching the owl?
examples.translation: ¿Estaba mirando el búho?

fixes.wrong: Did you playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

fixes.wrong: You were playing in the paddling pool?
fixes.right: Were you playing in the paddling pool?

drill.question: Pregunta si él estaba mirando el búho. ¿Cuál es correcta?
drill.explain: Con -ing, la pregunta empieza con was o were, no con did.

blocks.text: Esta forma sirve para pintar el fondo: qué estaba haciendo la gente cuando empezó la historia. I was changing a flat tyre — «estaba cambiando una llanta ponchada». No es un hecho aparte, sino algo que estaba en marcha.

examples.en: I was changing a flat tyre.
examples.translation: Estaba cambiando una llanta ponchada.

examples.en: He was checking the windscreen wiper.
examples.translation: Estaba revisando el limpiaparabrisas.

examples.en: We were cleaning the rear-view mirror.
examples.translation: Estábamos limpiando el retrovisor.

examples.en: She was packing the nappy bag.
examples.translation: Estaba preparando la pañalera.

blocks.text: Si algo pasó en medio de un proceso, el proceso va con was / were + -ing, y el hecho, en pasado simple después de when: I was cleaning my boots when you called. La llamada fue corta y cortó lo otro.

examples.en: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.
examples.translation: Estaba limpiando mis botines cuando llamaste.

examples.en: She was packing her ballet flats when I called.
examples.translation: Estaba guardando sus flats cuando llamé.

examples.en: We were looking for an insole when you arrived.
examples.translation: Estábamos buscando una plantilla cuando llegaste.

examples.en: She was drawing a piece of driftwood when I arrived.
examples.translation: Estaba dibujando un trozo de madera de playa cuando llegué.

fixes.wrong: I cleaned my ankle boots when you were calling.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

fixes.wrong: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you were call.
fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

drill.prompt: Di: «Estábamos buscando una plantilla cuando llegaste».

sections.title: while — dos procesos a la vez

blocks.text: while es «mientras». Se usa cuando dos cosas estaban pasando al mismo tiempo, y las dos llevan was / were + -ing: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.

examples.en: I was looking up while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Yo miraba hacia arriba mientras tomabas una foto.

examples.en: She was sniffing the flowers while I was talking.
examples.translation: Olía las flores mientras yo hablaba.

examples.en: We were giggling while he was telling the story.
examples.translation: Nos reíamos mientras él contaba la historia.

examples.en: I was cutting celery while you were cooking.
examples.translation: Yo cortaba apio mientras tú cocinabas.

blocks.text: Un hecho corto que interrumpe: when + pasado simple — when you called («cuando llamaste»). Un proceso largo al mismo tiempo: while + was / were + -ing — while you were cooking («mientras cocinabas»).

examples.en: We were watching a wasp when you called.
examples.translation: Estábamos mirando una avispa cuando llamaste.

examples.en: I was watching a butterfly while you were taking a photo.
examples.translation: Yo miraba una mariposa mientras tomabas una foto.

examples.en: I was turning around when you called my name.
examples.translation: Me estaba volteando cuando dijiste mi nombre.

drill.why: Dos procesos al mismo tiempo: while.

sections.title: Los errores que comete casi todo el mundo

fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.wrong: I was read a comic book.
fixes.right: I was reading a comic book.

fixes.right: They were doing a jigsaw puzzle.

fixes.right: I was cleaning my ankle boots when you called.

blocks.text: Lo que estaba pasando: was / were + -ing. Lo corto que lo interrumpió: pasado simple después de when. Did no va con -ing.
Algo en marcha: was / were + -ing, siempre con quién. «No»: wasn't / weren't. Pregunta: Was…? Were…? Interrumpió: when + pasado simple. Al mismo tiempo: while + was / were + -ing.

examples.en: I was filling a spray bottle.
examples.translation: Estaba llenando un atomizador.

examples.en: Were you taking a photo of the woodpecker?
examples.translation: ¿Estabas tomando una foto del pájaro carpintero?

examples.en: I was looking at a starfish when you called.
examples.translation: Estaba mirando una estrella de mar cuando llamaste.

examples.en: I was using a glue stick while you were drawing.
examples.translation: Yo usaba la barra de pegamento mientras dibujabas.
